mechanism: Begin with an environmental disturbance that could still be mistaken for terrain, reveal one identifying feature before the full body, switch to a high or wide view that proves the complete geometry and its scale effect on the environment, then return to a lower viewpoint for one final proximity breach.

invariants.rule: Open on an environmental deformation that can still be mistaken for terrain.
invariants.ablation_failure: A full creature opening removes the reveal.

invariants.rule: Reveal one identifying feature while withholding most of the body.
invariants.ablation_failure: Several features at once collapse the ladder.

invariants.rule: Extend the partial form enough to establish directional body geometry.
invariants.ablation_failure: Jumping directly to the overhead body feels disconnected.

invariants.rule: Use one high or wide view to prove the complete geometry and its environmental consequence.
invariants.ablation_failure: A close body texture gives no spatial proof.

invariants.rule: Return to a lower viewpoint for one bounded proximity breach.
invariants.purpose: Converts distant scale into immediate stakes.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending only overhead remains an illustration.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is clear without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: causal_carrier
slots.constraint: One object, route, mark or device that visibly carries the causal chain.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: Five ordered states with observable handoffs, not a decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A new proof-oriented information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final consequence that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of story-world cues supporting each visible change.

anti_copy_exclusions: green glowing eyes and storm sea
